TwiFF (Think With Future Frames): A Large-Scale Dataset for Dynamic Visual Reasoning
	


  
    
  
  
    
  
  
    
  
  
    
  



	
	
	
		🧠 Method
	


We present TwiFF, a unified model fine-tuned on a high-quality dynamic visual Chain-of-Thought (VCoT) dataset comprising 2.7 million samples.
